additional_concerns: Exposure measurement, LAF identification and operative designation are supplied judgments. The formula does not establish their factual or legal correctness. OMITS findings for upstream assessments do not alone establish a defect in the scoped classification formula.

Footnote 7 limits the holistic designation assessment to exposure below 50% of NAV. The OR preserves the outcome when the automatic threshold is met, but does not implement this procedural qualification or establish designation persistence.

The global conflict-blocking rule adds an evidentiary restriction not stated in the circular: conflict on an otherwise unnecessary branch can block an independently established route. CONFLICT must not be interpreted as absence of classification.

FALSE requires both retained routes to be established absent for an in-scope Fund. It does not establish non-complex status under other regimes, declassification following reduced exposure, or permission to sell.
The three missing dependency IDs have no supplied authority-name mapping. None can reliably be assigned to a named missing authority.

Other absent authorities include the LAF circular 25EC9, UT Code section 7.3, Internal Product Approval Process circular 16EC11 and the referenced Advertising Guidelines. They concern separate regimes or obligations; their absence does not itself defeat the retained classification predicate.

For the open-ended examples claim, the circular supplies all authority necessary to establish the stated proposition. Whether subsequent SFC updates are needed for a particular assessment occasion remains unresolved; this separate uncertainty is retained in the follow-up.
